faqs.q: Sec. 102-205. - User charges; distributor and institutions.
faqs.a:
The charges for sanitary sewer service for campus-type institutions, special districts
               or to facilities served by user-owned, user-maintained collection systems will be
               established by agreement between the city and such user. The charges will be established
               to reflect reasonably the cost of service.
(Code 1981, § 33-109; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
